## User Story

**As a** registered user,
**I need** to log in securely with my email and password,
**So that** I can access my personal dashboard and data.

## Acceptance Criteria

**Given** I am on the login page,
**When** I enter a valid email and password and click Login,
**Then** I should be redirected to my dashboard.

**Given** I am on the login page,
**When** I enter an incorrect password,
**Then** I should see an error message "Invalid email or password".

**Given** I am logged in,
**When** I click Logout,
**Then** I should be returned to the home page.

## Estimate
Story Points: 5

## Sprint / Milestone
Sprint 1 - MVP Launch
